| ASM-001 | P-1 | PER-CIO | The product directory holds no organizational policy (EXT-ORG-POLICY); the organization's role appointments, strategy and baseline direction are recorded as stated by the simulated organization-level personas. | The fictional product package contains only system material; P-1 to P-7 need an organizational position. |
| ASM-002 | P-2 | PER-RE | The organization's risk tolerance, three-year maximum authorization period and remediation periods (30/90/180/365 days by risk level) are fictional organizational policy for this example. | No organizational risk management policy is supplied; R-2 and R-4 need a concrete tolerance to compare against. |
| ASM-003 | P-3 | PER-RE | The organization-level threat picture (data-link electronic warfare, equipment capture, removable-media malicious code, supply chain, disconnected operations) is a generic fictional summary; no threat product (EXT-THREAT) is supplied. | P-3 needs threat information and the product directory has none. |
| ASM-004 | P-5 | PER-CISO | The Component provides the pm family and the policy and procedure parts of each family's first control as organization-wide common controls. | The product names only the enclave as a leveraged provider; organization-wide program controls are usual but not documented. |
| ASM-005 | P-7 | PER-RE | The organizational continuous monitoring frequencies, metrics and reporting cadence are fictional organizational policy for this example. | No organizational continuous monitoring strategy is supplied; S-5 needs one to follow. |
| ASM-006 | P-9 | PER-PM | The supported brigade's operations staff is the information owner for ETGCS mission data, represented by the test platoon leader during EMD; the milestone decision authority and capability sponsor are informed through milestone reviews. | The stakeholder list names no information owner or milestone decision authority. |
| ASM-007 | P-12 | PER-IO | Mission information types map to SP 800-60 Vol. 2 D.1.3 (tactical defense) and security management data to C.3.5.5 and C.3.5.8; map data is an organization-defined type. | The product gives information categories but no SP 800-60 mapping; C-2 confirms or revises it. |
| ASM-008 | P-15 | PER-PM | No capability document (EXT-CAPDOC) or organizational policy is supplied; requirements rest on the CONOPS, the stakeholders' answers, the risk assessment and DoDI 8510.01. | P-15 lists EXT-CAPDOC and EXT-ORG-POLICY as inputs and the product directory has neither. |
| ASM-009 | P-18 | PER-PM | The Component system registry (EXT-REGISTRY) is simulated; the registration record reference ETGCS-REG-SIM-0001 is fictional. | P-18 needs a registry record and none is supplied. |
| ASM-010 | I-1 | PER-DEV | The STIG and SRG release versions and the rule IDs in stig-summary.yaml (SV-9001xx) are fictional placeholders; the product material names the benchmarks and results but not their releases or rule numbers. | STIG-001 and the stig-summary schema need a version and a rule ID per record; the program's build records are not in the product material. |
